summary: Master low-code application development. Build enterprise apps, automate workflows, and lead citizen development initiatives. Enroll for expert-led training.
lede: Low-code application development helps business and technology professionals turn operational needs into digital tools without traditional coding. Learners practice relational data modeling, workflow automation and interface design, then explore API integrations and approaches to deployment, security and governance. Practical exercises include building applications and automating processes.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for professionals who sit at the intersection of business strategy and technical execution, requiring the ability to build functional digital solutions without deep traditional coding expertise.
modules: Deployment Strategy and Center of Excellence
prerequisites: Participants should have a strong working knowledge of business processes and basic data concepts (e.g., working with Excel tables or simple databases). No prior coding experience in languages like Java or Python is required, but familiarity with logic-based formulas (similar to Excel IF/LOOKUP functions) is highly recommended.
